title: Offer your services.
subtitle: Find customers across Mozambique. No monthly fee: the platform keeps a fixed percentage of each booking, and the rest is yours.

apply.title: Apply
apply.body: Create the account and tell us what you do and where.

review.title: Verification
review.body: We confirm who you are before customers can see you.

publish.title: Publish services
publish.body: Set prices, duration and the hours you are available.

earn.title: Get paid
earn.body: The customer pays by M-Pesa once you confirm the time. The commission comes out of the price.

identity.title: Proof of identity
identity.body: An ID card, passport or driving licence, so we can confirm you are who you say.

payout.title: A way to be paid
payout.body: An M-Pesa number, where your earnings go.

terms.title: Accept the terms
terms.body: The platform's rules, including what happens when a booking goes wrong.

closingBody: Joining is free, and there is nothing to pay until your first booking.
pathsLine: Work on your own, or as an establishment with a team and one calendar per staff member.
